sources_considered.why: Readable official introduction dates GPT-5's release to August 7, 2025, after the stipulated year.
A potentially useful contemporary statement about release plans, but read_page returned HTTP 403. The actual release announcement is stronger evidence than a plan.

evidence_items.locator: Opening paragraph under the August 7, 2025 publication date

receipt.public_excerpt: We are introducing GPT‑5, our best AI system yet.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI's official introduction places the named GPT-5 release in August 2025, outside calendar 2024. The named-model antecedent therefore was not met, regardless of whether the later release was mindblowing.

unresolved_gaps: A broader reading that substitutes any GPT-5-level advance would require a capability threshold Marcus did not supply.
The counterfactual market response to a qualifying 2024 GPT-5 release cannot be observed.
